summary: The article provides generally accurate information regarding ITR deadlines and tax audit requirements for FY 2025-26, but contains a few inaccuracies regarding specific dates and penalty amounts.

claims.claim: The deadline to file your Income Tax Return (ITR) for Financial Year 2025-26 (Assessment Year 2026-27) is September 30, 2026, if your accounts need to be audited.
claims.note: The ITR filing deadline for businesses requiring an audit for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) is October 31, 2026. However, the tax audit report itself must be filed by September 30, 2026.

claims.claim: Businesses: If your total sales, turnover, or gross receipts in the Financial Year 2025-26 exceeded ₹1 crore. This limit is increased to ₹10 crores if at least 95% of your business transactions (both receipts and payments) are done digitally.
claims.note: This claim is accurate as per Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act for FY 2025-26.

claims.claim: Professionals: If your gross receipts from your profession (like doctors, lawyers, architects) exceeded ₹50 lakhs in FY 2025-26.
claims.note: This claim is accurate as per Section 44AB of the Income Tax Act for FY 2025-26.

claims.claim: If you miss the September 30th deadline, you might have to pay a penalty. For instance, a late filing fee of up to ₹5,000 can be levied.
claims.note: A late filing fee of ₹5,000 is applicable if total income is above ₹5 lakh, and ₹1,000 if total income is ₹5 lakh or less.

claims.claim: You can still file a 'belated return' (also called an updated return in some cases) for FY 2025-26, usually until December 31, 2026.
claims.note: The deadline for filing a belated return for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) is December 31, 2026.

claims.claim: Yes, if you file your original ITR by the September 30th deadline, you can generally revise it if you find any errors or omissions, typically until December 31, 2026.
claims.note: The deadline for filing a revised return for FY 2025-26 (AY 2026-27) is March 31, 2027, or before the completion of assessment, whichever is earlier.

article_title: Don't Miss Your ITR Deadline if Your Accounts Need an Audit!
